name: University of the Punjab (PU), Lahore
_note: Basic criteria (Matric/4 + FA/FSc + additional marks over Matric total/4 + FA/FSc total) and closing figures from 'Undergraduate Programs Merit of Last Year 2025' (Directorate of Students Affairs, pu.edu.pk). Test-based formula (75% academic + 25% entry test) from PU's official basic merit calculator. Records: BS 1st semester and BS 5th semester, morning and evening/replica/self-support columns as printed; figures given in marks, 'Nil', 'new program', ambiguous cells and gender-split Sheikh Zayed figures are not stored.

formulas.label: BS 1st semester, basic criteria (no entry test)
formulas.source_note: Merit of Last Year 2025, p. 1, 'Basic Criteria for BS (4-Yrs) Program': marks earned (1/4 of Matric + FA/FSc + additional marks) / total marks (1/4 of Matric + FA/FSc). With 1100 + 1100 totals Matric counts 20% and FSc 80%.

formulas.label: BS 1st semester with an entry test (75% academic + 25% test)
formulas.source_note: PU Basic Criteria Merit Calculator, 1st semester BS (4-Yrs): ((Matric/4 + Inter + additional) / (Matric total/4 + Inter total)) x 75 + (test obtained / test total) x 25.
